conventions.confirmation: Commands marked destructive ask on a terminal, and need --yes when stdin or stderr is not one, or with --output json.
conventions.context: --context, else GRUND_CONTEXT, else the current context (grund context use). A context is an instance, its credential and an organisation; grund auth login makes one.
conventions.credentials: GRUND_TOKEN (a personal access token, grund_pat_…) and GRUND_INSTANCE, else the context's credential, kept in the config file (mode 0600; GRUND_CONFIG, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/grund/config.yaml).
conventions.dry_run: --dry-run prints grund.cli.v1.DryRun (app deploy: grund.cli.v1.DeployResult with dryRun set) and changes nothing. A release's dry run is checked by the instance as a deploy is.
conventions.errors: A failed command prints grund.cli.v1.ErrorOutput on stderr with --output json, and exits with its code's status.
conventions.organisation: --org, else GRUND_ORG, else the context's (grund org use), else the token's organisation, else the account's only one.
conventions.output: --output json (or --json, or GRUND_OUTPUT=json) prints one JSON document on stdout: the protobuf JSON of the message the command's output names. Fields at their default may be absent. 64-bit integers are strings.

exit_codes.meaning: The command line is wrong: an unknown flag, a missing argument or a bad value.
A destructive command needs --yes when nobody can be asked.
More than one organisation could be meant: pass --org or run grund org use.
No credential: run grund auth login, or set GRUND_TOKEN and GRUND_INSTANCE.
The instance refused the credential: unknown, revoked or expired.
The credential may not do this: the role, or the token's scope.
No such organisation, app, release, machine, domain, member or token, or not one the credential reaches.
The current state refuses it: a name taken, a limit reached, a rollout halted.
The instance refused the input; field names it when known.
The instance could not be reached or could not answer now; retrying may work.
With --wait: the release did not go live.
